## ServiceNow highlighted as rate-sensitive growth pick in lower-rate scenario analysis

ServiceNow sits at the intersection of two live debates — enterprise AI monetization and rate-driven growth equity re-rating; a confirmed Fed easing path could provide a dual catalyst for NOW, making the macro-rate angle worth integrating into the position thesis.

- A simplywall.st piece names NOW among two growth stocks suited for lower interest rate expectations
- The framing links ServiceNow's valuation sensitivity to rate trajectory rather than standalone fundamentals
- Enterprise AI adoption is implicitly embedded in the NOW thesis but not detailed in the headline
- Macro rate expectations are presented as the primary catalyst for NOW re-rating
